packageRules.description: Test-only infrastructure ships nothing to production, so a bad version can only turn the required 'Build and Test (.NET)' check red, which already blocks the merge. That makes these self-policing, so all update types automerge including majors.

PublicApiGenerator is referenced only by the Abstractions and Http test projects, where it drives approved-API snapshot tests. A behavioural change in it breaks those snapshots, which turns the required check red, so it cannot land silently.

Microsoft.Playwright is a runtime dependency of Sanare.Browser, not a test package, and the Category=Browser tests that would exercise it are excluded from CI because no Chromium is installed on the runner. Nothing in CI meaningfully covers a Playwright bump, so these stay manual.
